description:
Issue filters are declared per command and parsed ad hoc at about 14 sites. One flattened argument group with one conversion fixes the declarations and the parse in one place.

## Background

Filter fields are plain `String`/`Vec<String>` in `crates/jit/src/cli.rs`: `Commands::List`, bare `Commands::Query`, `IssueCommands::List` and `QueryCommands::All` take state, assignee, priority and label; `QueryCommands::{Available, Blocked, Strategic, Closed}` take priority and label; `QueryCommands::Count` takes label; `IssueCommands::Search` takes state, assignee, priority and `labels` (long `--label`). They are parsed in `crates/jit/src/main.rs` by `run_query_all` (`State::from_str`, `Priority::from_str`), by the `IssueCommands::Search` arm (`State::from_str`, `Priority::from_str`, `Assignee::from_str`; its labels go to `QueryOps::search_issues_with_filters`, which since 86583a988 validates them through `validate_label_pattern`, matches them by pattern and reports `INVALID_LABEL_PATTERN`), and by `Priority::from_str` in the available, blocked, strategic and closed arms; the executor checks label patterns in `validate_label_pattern` (`crates/jit/src/commands/query.rs`, `InvalidLabelPatternError`, accepts `ns:*`). `--filter` on `issue update` and `issue claim-next` is a query-language expression, not a field filter.

The design: `IssueFilterArgs` (`#[derive(Args)]` in `cli.rs`, flattened with `#[command(flatten)]`) holds the raw values and exposes one conversion over the existing `FromStr` types, so a bad value keeps its `INVALID_ARGUMENT` failure envelope rather than becoming a clap diagnostic. Label filters are patterns everywhere, and repeated `--label` stays the only multi-value form.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `cli.rs` defines `IssueFilterArgs`, and `list`, bare `query`, `issue list`, `issue search` and `query all|available|blocked|strategic|closed|count` take their field filters only through a flattened `IssueFilterArgs`.
- [hard] REQ-02: One `IssueFilterArgs` method converts the raw values into parsed filters (`Option<State>`, `Option<Priority>`, assignee, validated label patterns), and no other site in `crates/jit/src` outside the executor parses a filter string.
- [hard] REQ-03: An invalid `--state` or `--priority` still yields `INVALID_ARGUMENT` with exit 2 and a failure envelope under `--json`, and an invalid label pattern yields `INVALID_LABEL_PATTERN` on every filtering command.
- [hard] REQ-04: `issue search --label ns:*` matches by pattern, and tests state this new contract and the `INVALID_LABEL_PATTERN` code for an invalid search label where it reported `INVALID_ARGUMENT` before.
- [hard] REQ-05: Commands that accepted only a subset of the filters accept the whole group, each added filter narrowing the result by AND; a test states this for `query available`, and the existing suites pass without weakened assertions.

## Notes

Typed `value_parser`s and new vocabulary types (`Assignee`, a label-pattern type) belong to the semantic-types epic 2195c98f.

Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`; inventories with function and arm citations: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/investigation.md`.
title: Shared IssueFilterArgs group for issue filters
